boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 113 stacks three chambers vertically with a narrow neck between them that acts as a one-lane airlock. The top blue bar counter ticks from `7` down to `1`, tracking upper-chamber progress, and the middle neck only passes one piece at a time. Rotate the yellow 1×3 bar too early and it seals the only path into the lower chamber.
landmarks: Block Out Level 113 stacks three chambers vertically with a narrow neck between them that acts as a one-lane airlock.
The top blue bar counter ticks from `7` down to `1`, tracking upper-chamber progress, and the middle neck only passes one piece at a time.
Rotate the yellow 1×3 bar too early and it seals the only path into the lower chamber.

quickTips: The middle neck is exactly one lane wide — nothing can sit sideways in it.
Watch the top blue bar counter; the yellow 1×3 only moves once it drops below `4`.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Slide the orange 1×2 polyomino downward through the middle neck to begin opening the upper `7` chamber.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Hold the yellow 1×3 horizontal until the top blue bar counter drops from `7` to `4`.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Feed the yellow 1×3 through the neck once the upper purple `7` block thins to a single row.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Drop the remaining upper-chamber debris through the neck airlock while the side `7` pads still read open.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Send the green L-piece and blue L-cluster through the neck into the lower `1` chamber.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Clear the lower purple `1` block through the side `3` and `4` pads, then exit the red L-piece at the bottom.

failurePoints: Rotating the yellow 1×3 before the top counter drops below `4`, which seals the neck.
Feeding the lower `1` chamber before the upper `7` block has fully drained.
